en: The postcard features a sepia-toned photograph of a street called Zöblitzerstraße in Olbernhau, a town in the Erzgebirge (Ore Mountains) region. The scene includes early 20th-century European buildings, notably a prominent brick building with ornate architecture and turrets on the right and another multi-story building labeled 'Hotel Amtshof' on the left. The street is empty, and the atmosphere feels historical.
